preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and x >= 1 for x in map(int, stdin.split()))
preconditions.description: All input numbers are positive integers.
The first line of each test case is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6), followed by n distinct integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if all(abs(a.index(x) - sorted(a).index(x)) <= 1 for x in a) else stdout.strip() == 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if every element in the input sequence is at most 1 position away from its correct position in the sorted sequence; otherwise output 'NO'.
